e.title: Double Lift (CAS)
e.summary: CAS 官方 Double Lift 图（9★）：保险模型评估的标准可视化
e.body:
Double Lift（casact/double_lift，9★）是 CAS 官方的 Double Lift 图 Python 实现：保险定价/核保模型评估的标准可视化（对比模型分段表现）。对 RIAA：模型评估的工具——[[machine-learning-pricing]] 模型上线前用 lift 图看分段表现；与 [[observable-plot]]（图表）、[[ins-actbench]]（基准）组成「建模 → 评估 → 可视化」链；CAS 官方背书。

## 同类工具
[[end-to-end-automl-insurance]]、[[ergodic-insurance-limits]]、[[extreme-stats-jl]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.verified_note: 源码核实：CAS 官方仓库 9★ + 描述确认（Double Lift 图），未实测
e.summary_en: CAS-official Double Lift charts (9★): standard visualization for insurance model evaluation
e.summary_hk: CAS 官方 Double Lift 圖（9★）：保險模型評估的標準可視化
e.body_en:
Double Lift (casact/double_lift, 9★) is the CAS-official Python implementation of Double Lift charts: the standard visualization for evaluating insurance pricing/underwriting models (segment-wise model comparison). For RIAA: a model-evaluation tool — inspect segment performance with lift charts before shipping [[machine-learning-pricing]] models; with [[observable-plot]] (charts) and [[ins-actbench]] (benchmark) it forms a model-evaluate-visualize chain; CAS-official backing.

## Similar tools
[[end-to-end-automl-insurance]]、[[ergodic-insurance-limits]]、[[extreme-stats-jl]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
